# requires: wire
#
# A resume against a server that does ranges properly. Everything the other wire
# scenarios distort is correct here, so a divergence in this one is the harness
# and not the contract.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:plain
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
